global_issues.title: Alibaba launches AI chip rival to Nvidia amid export controls
global_issues.note: Confirmed by Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Forkast, 24/7 Wall St (2026-09-22): Alibaba unveiled Zhenwu V900 (216GB HBM, up to 500K-unit clusters), BABA jumped ~4% on the news, explicitly framed as filling the gap left by Nvidia export controls. SMCI Taiwan raid and ~7-8% share drop also confirmed for this week. One caveat: several outlets note the underlying Taiwan probe originated from earlier raids in May/June 2026 and this is an escalation/continuation, not a brand-new investigation — worth noting the briefing implies it's a fresh event when it's actually the probe deepening. V900 mass production is not until Q1 2027, so 'launches' overstates commercial availability (it was unveiled/announced, not shipped).

global_issues.title: Middle East oil supply risks persist as prices fall below $100
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Brent fell to ~$100/barrel Monday, extending a 4-session slide on Iran de-escalation diplomacy talks, per CNBC/Reuters coverage from the period. Houthi/Yemen attacks on Saudi energy facilities and Hormuz risk remain live concerns (Goldman warned of a possible spike above $120 if attacks intensify), consistent with the briefing's framing of persistent risk despite the price pullback.
